profile.headline: Software Engineer at Meta
profile.summary:
I am a software developer who is intent on working to produce social value through the tech industry. Through my background in teaching special education, I have developed my abilities to stay composed under pressure, break down complex issues, and find creative methods to solve problems. I’m able to both bring my critical thinking skills to the table and maintain empathy for my teammates, supervisors, and clients. In the workplace, as well as in life, I am constantly striving to learn what I can and teach what I know. My passion for helping others drives me to be a cooperative group member, but does not hinder my ability to speak out when I feel necessary.

1800 Lichess.org rating, soccer enthusiast, perennial teacher and learner.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · On-site
positions.description:
-Maintained a public containerized React site and learning platform providing services for 10,000+ unique users per month.
-Eliminated technical debt by migrating both React components and Node/Express middleware functions to TypeScript, increasing stability and security of the codebase, while minimizing the potential for bugs in the future.
-Constructed unit tests with Jest and React Testing Library for React components, Node/Express routes and middleware, and internal utility tools, improving overall reliability and consistency within the application.
-Supervised engineering teams through the Agile Scrum process to facilitate their engineering efficiency while building full-stack applications designed to solve developer problems in Kubernetes, Cypress, and RabbitMQ.
-Conducted in-depth code reviews through GitHub for junior engineers and pull requests made to the main application.
-Administered technical interviews to potential engineering candidates, assessing their deep knowledge of JavaScript, problem-solving ability, critical thinking, technical communication, and cultural fit.
positions.insights: Skills: Node.js · Front-End Development · TypeScript · React.js · Full-Stack Development · Express.js · Jest · PostgreSQL · DevOps · Redux.js · HTML

positions.description: Skills: Front-End Development · TypeScript · Full-Stack Development · Jest · PostgreSQL · DevOps · Redux.js · HTML

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · On-site
positions.description:
-Implemented WebAssembly as the backbone of the package to take advantage of other languages (C++ and Go) at near native performance by compiling them into WASM binary for use in a Node.js/Express server with JavaScript glue code.

-Developed compilation instructions and commands for implementation of a WebAssembly module using Emscripten and TinyGo, which allows for seamless integration by users downloading the NPM package.

-Used the advantages of TypeScript throughout to improve type security, ensure that code is maintainable and scalable, and reduce unintended consequences of JavaScript’s flexibility, such as type coercion.

-Employed Jest and React testing library to write granular unit tests for functions and frontend components to ensure outputs were consistent and retain functionality when modified or expanded upon.

-Made use of Chart.js to display benchmarked data showing the speed metrics of C++ and Go over JS when running a computationally expensive recursive function.

-Deployed splash page for NPM package using AWS Amplify and added continuous integration through GitHub actions for automated redeployment upon updates to the production branch, abstracting a part of the development process.
positions.insights: Skills: Node.js · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · TypeScript · React.js · Chart.js · MongoDB · HTML · WebAssembly
